meta.platinumEstimate: About 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough (PowerPyx roadmap).
meta.listSource: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation, as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase (the two agree on every name, description and grade).
meta.guideNote: Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide. Each cites the source its facts come from; a source is named or linked, never copied. Methods marked unconfirmed are ones no published guide had pinned down by 20 November 2026, the day after launch.
warnings: Cheats disable trophies and saving for the session (PowerPyx, GTABase). Keep cheats off during a trophy run.
There is no mission replay. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter: 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave (PowerPyx).
Only one trophy is possibly missable: Positive Mental Attitude, the Chapter 1 meditation. Everything else can be done after the story in free-roam (PowerPyx).

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story, Chapters 1–5 (about 60–80 hours)
roadmap.text: Finish the story and enjoy it. All 12 story trophies pop automatically as chapters and named missions end, and the side-character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) open as the story goes and stay open after it. Two things to do on the way: in Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house the morning after the mission Down to Earth — it may be the one missable trophy. And scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars whenever you meet new ones, since the 100% checklist counts them later. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — The 100% checklist and 70 of 80 challenges (about 100 hours)
roadmap.text: After the story, the 100% checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles are only partly needed, and you only need 70 of the 80 challenges. The lines that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Working through it also earns the stunt, shooting-range, race, card-set, meditation, vehicle-scan and animal-study trophies.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous cleanup (about 10 hours)
roadmap.text: Mop up what is left: the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, the duo robberies and wanted-level feats with your partner, the one-off feats (plane theft, tank theft, UFO, bowling, the showroom Banshee), the money trophies and the garages. Nothing here is missable, and every quest giver tied to a trophy is still around in free-roam.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no separate task: follow the roadmap, finish the 100% checklist for A Long Road, and this is the last trophy you get.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, so it is one of the first trophies you will earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes it lands as the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins. Just play through the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as Chapter 3 opens with the mission Welcome to Vice City. No side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. PowerPyx places it after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, which is when the game counts Chapter 3 as done. Keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 4's final main mission, Starting From Zero, is done. Finish the chapter's missions in order and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the game's final mission, after which the open world stays available in free-roam and the 100% checklist opens. This is the last story trophy.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Play the mission through and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Finish the mission and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Just complete the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Finish the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Complete the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and it unlocks.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the backbone of Stage 2. After the story, the checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion; progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion: you need any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 70 of 80 challenges, and only some collectible types in part. The lines that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Work the checklist line by line and this pops near the end of the run.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the world — you can mix the four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. PowerPyx calls the under-bridge flights the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name and marker. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and find them on the map filtered to Activities (blue dumbbell icons). Most come up on their own while you work on the other trophies, so check what is left and do that one thing.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. PowerPyx links a guide to every range and gold-medal target; the ranges are also needed in full for the 100% checklist, so this is a Stage 2 job, not a quick one. Practise a range until the gold time or score is comfortable, then move to the next.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, per PowerPyx. You only need one win per location for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all the drone races, so the full set is worth learning. Pick the easiest race at each spot first and come back for the rest in Stage 2.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, and there are 40 unique race locations in the game, per PowerPyx. Work through the race spots on the map and take the win at each; a race you have already won does not count twice, so spread out instead of repeating a favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map west of Key Lento. Go to the spot and take the fishing challenge against him — beat his catch and the trophy pops. It stays available after the story, so there is no rush if you miss his first message.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines out in the world. You only need to reach the end of one game — beating every challenge inside it is not required. Pick the game you like best and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline opens automatically in Chapter 3 and is Lucia-only. While playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Her five quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams he calls you, and his green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He marks shipwrecks on the map as purple treasure-chest icons: dive, use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, and bring it back to him. There are 7 shipwrecks to clear in total, in several sets — after each set he calls you back for more. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees or Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. His five quests are Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. Not every side questline counts — PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others do not count as strangers for this trophy. Strands confirmed to count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts: Skunk Apeology 101, Search for Tree Effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (the street-race mentoring chain) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and his delivery jobs). PowerPyx notes more counting strangers are still being found, so keep doing stranger strands in free-roam and watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, opens automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City): the Zorrusso from the story mission plus the Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. He marks some cars for you in fixed spots, but you can also steal one off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, then drive it to him. Delivering in good condition pays more. The list is tracked under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and it can all be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline opens automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is Jason-only. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to them and destroy the labs (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter). Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finishing it pops the trophy. It all stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you cannot do the last one until both characters can be played together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE WARNING: one meditation is only available in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so PowerPyx and GTABase both say it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author earned the trophy after doing it. Do it in Chapter 1; there is no way back afterwards. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 spots are needed, so this warning is about this trophy, not A Long Road.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline opens automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break and is Jason-only: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Do it and he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map — hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back to him as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. One clean shot leaves an animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track his quests under Map > Activities > Target Deck (15 decks in total, all needed for 100%). PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy, so work through Bret's hunts and it should land on the way.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. There are 480 cards in total across the sets, per the FullSweep wiki, so do not try to finish everything — pick three sets and hunt their cards with PowerPyx's set-location guide, which maps all 18 sets. Cards also appear in the world as you explore, so check the collection menu to see which sets are closest to done before choosing.

sources.name: GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List (3 of 18 sets)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app: hold Up to open WAiNK, look at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture and hold R1 to scan it. There are far more than 100 — PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the No Flusher tags — so any 100 will do. Scan whatever you pass while exploring and this fills up on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (eight groups of ten). You need 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way there. View and track them under Progress > Challenges — each one shows a Completed tick when you scroll over it. Most fill in naturally while you work on other trophies; when you are near the end, pick the easiest unfinished ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Earliest chance is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level (cause carnage until it hits 4 stars), then escape the red heat zone on the map. PowerPyx's tip: take a fast sports motorcycle and cut through traffic, and if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it leaves; driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County works well because the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone. You will also get it naturally in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the large bank vault robberies there always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then rob 3 shops in a row — the green robbery icons on the map — while staying wanted the whole time. You need to keep the flashing red/blue wanted level going, not the red heat level. PowerPyx advises an armoured vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and says the 3 jewellery stores in the north of Vice City are a good spot (available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): rob a couple of items in each store and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not come, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Open the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up to use it at once — then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. You only need to scan a vehicle, not drive it. The fastest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time, highlights weak spots and drains the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. You must drop 5 enemies in one use, which lasts only a few seconds. PowerPyx's method: buff your focus first (eat or drink, or wash your face / shower at home), take Adrenaline to stretch the focus time (hold L1, press Triangle), line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556, wearing body armour from Ammu-Nations so you can step out of cover. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by the time you reach Focus Level 4 it is much easier, and it may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door leading straight into it (or walk in through the terminal on foot). Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it lands.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — get into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. Expect the base to fight back, so be ready to drive out fast once it unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewellery store robberies with green icons on the map. Break into a jewellery store through the back door with the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory, no need to equip it; kicking the door sets the alarm off, so use the Snap Gun prompt instead. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults. They open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which is marked from story progress: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — go in fast and rob it, bringing your partner along to hand off a bag (hold Right). After that quest you can pay Yasmani $10,000 for tips that mark security vans with a purple icon (finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first if you have not). Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognisable. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, the same mission that opens the bank vault robberies: tailing the armoured truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. Escape the red heat radius afterwards (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). You can also do it earlier: armoured trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs; Yasmani becomes a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The quickest way, per PowerPyx, is to take a plane and fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Do it in Stage 2 when you have a plane handy and the map is mostly open already.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; they appear as yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs (scroll over a gang to see how many of its operations you have robbed). The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops early on the way there.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops once you have had the drink with the view. A quick one-off — do it whenever you are in Vice City.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car — the blue Banshee in the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City — and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs: hack into the car, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving away — the pop is slightly delayed. No other car works; it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not needed. You first go here in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but the trophy is not missable: if you do not get all three items, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can go back for what is left.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, selecting a character and scrolling to Strength (heart icon). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always train together — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle: while one character works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many around Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see the count by clicking this trophy in the trophy list, and PowerPyx suggests turning on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile, so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something counts. The profile runs from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable is permanent if you keep using excessive violence — avoid that one. Almost every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so it fills passively; if it is the last one left, farming it by running over civilians and cops in a car works, though cops will shoot on sight more at Psycho or Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no published guide had pinned this one down by 20 November 2026. PowerPyx marks it currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner; the store is in Little Cuba, Vice City. Do not chase this one until a guide confirms the method — the description ('Second time's the charm') fits a second visit, but that is a guess, not a fact. Check PowerPyx's guide again after launch week for an update.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it is. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted: talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy pops. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the place to do it — ride slowly through a crowd, kick as you pass, and keep the count going until ten are down inside the minute.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder them. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip, and it comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist: the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, once they open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. It counts cumulatively across the whole run, so most of it happens naturally — but if you need to finish it off, the fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores to spend in.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story-related garages do not count for this one. They cost $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone: buy them through the app. Robberies are the quick way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which lets you have a registered vehicle delivered to you wherever you are. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). You need enough garage space first — each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages (see Little Boxes) before registering. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes if you want to keep the bill down.
